## Problem
Clear description of the bug. What went wrong?

## User Value

## Test Evidence
How will this be tested? (unit test, manual demo, calibration footage)

## Claim Discipline Reminder
- No accuracy/impact figures without documented tests
- Human review mandatory — no automatic fines
- Label as WORKING / DEMO STAGE / PLANNED / EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY
